reason: The cited evidence shows that adiabatic shear bands can form in some HEAs at high strain rates (E2), but it does not link them to enhanced penetration properties, nor does it address the Co-free FeNiCrMn system specifically. The premise that FeNiCrMn retains comparable performance to CoCrFeMnNi is not supported by the cited passages, and the mechanism's applicability to this alloy is assumed without direct evidence.
premises: Adiabatic shear bands form in HEAs at high strain rates or large deformation
Adiabatic shear bands enhance penetration properties
The Co-free FeNiCrMn system retains comparable mechanical performance to CoCrFeMnNi
Dynamic properties of HEAs are sensitive to strain rate and temperature
The proposed mechanism applies specifically to solidified FeNiCrMn
